name: adrv9361-loopback-8slot
description: ADRV9361-Z7035 (lablp) FastLock pin-select hops, RX and TX, at 15.36 MSPS. Slot k = (rx_lo, tx_lo) = FastLock profile k = Tick CTRL_IN code k; profile 0 is live before hop 0. With the TX DDS tone at f_dds over the TX1->RX1 coupling, the RX tone sits at tx_lo - rx_lo + f_dds: +1, +3, -2, +5, -4, +2, -3, +4.5 MHz for slots 0..7, all inside +/-0.4 fs (6.144 MHz), at least 1 MHz from DC, and different (also from the previous tone's image) on every consecutive hop. Each round of eight is TX-only, RX-only, both, TX-only, RX-only, both, TX-only, both (0->1 moves only TX, 1->2 only RX, 2->3 both, ..., 7->0 both). Period 1.25 s: above the 1 s floor (one completion ack over network IIO per hop, ~1 s stalls on lablp), and not a whole second, so the hops sample four phases of the PPS second (the time base's two oscillators drift within each second). settle 0 and a 4 ms capture keep the hop transient in the window.
